install.nodes_about: Tagging, background removal, detailer, detection and upscale nodes. Third-party nodes come from their own repositories at the tested versions; the app's pack is copied. Restart the image server afterwards.
install.restart_confirm: Restart the image server? Running generation is interrupted.
install.no_comfy: The image server folder was not found. Start it or set its folder in Settings → Image.
install.broken_links: Broken links: {names}. Remove them to install there.
install.legacy_packs: Other atelierx_* folders that may register the same nodes: {names}
install.models_about: Saved into a model folder the image server reads and checked against the published sha256. Each model has its own license; check the link. Files already there are skipped.
install.comfy_off: Start the image server so its model folders are known.
install.trainer_about: Downloads anima_lora ({commit}, {license}), builds its own Python environment (Python 3.13, CUDA PyTorch, several GB the first time) and applies the model-path patch. Empty training settings (folder, LoRA output folder, training models) are filled in.
install.trainer_confirm: Install the LoRA trainer? The first time downloads several GB and takes a while.
install.trainer_settings: Change the paths in Settings → Image → LoRA training. Get the training models above under Models.
server.installs.patch_failed: The patch does not fit this trainer version.
server.installs.hash: The downloaded file does not match: {name}
server.installs.busy: Another install is running. Wait for it to finish.
server.installs.no_comfy: The image server folder was not found. Start it or set its folder in Settings → Image.
server.installs.comfy_off: Start the image server first; models go into the folders it reads.
server.installs.no_folder: The image server has no folder for {kind}.
server.installs.folder_taken: The trainer folder is not empty: {path}
server.installs.restart_failed: The image server did not come back. Start it yourself.
tabs.close_forms_warning:
These tabs may contain unsaved form entries. Close them?

llm_tools.title: LLM tools
llm_tools.instructions: Review focus, content to preserve, or instructions
llm_tools.format_hint: Desired structure (optional; otherwise preserve content and headings)
llm_tools.review_note: Results are saved for review. Your source is not changed automatically.
llm_tools.save_first: Save did not complete. Check the save status and try again.
llm_tools.queued: Task started. Open the result from the review notification when ready.
llm_tools.no_issues: No issues reported. This does not guarantee correctness.
run_llm.title: For this run
run_llm.hint: Applies to requests from this screen without changing saved settings. Leave model blank to use the task default or selected connection's default.
settings.platform_independent_note: Manage each platform’s name and document size limits.
settings.platform_limits_note: Counts body text in UTF-8 bytes. Blank means unlimited; 0 means a zero-byte limit.
settings.platform_delete_confirm: Delete this platform? Platforms used by a work or as the default cannot be deleted.
settings.platform_discard_confirm: Discard unsaved changes and switch platforms?
server.presets.invalid: A preset must be an object.
server.presets.invalid_id: Preset IDs may use letters, digits, underscores, and hyphens.
server.presets.invalid_limit: Limits must be non-negative integers or unset.
server.presets.readonly: The generic preset is read-only. Duplicate it to edit.
server.editor.bad_format_mode: Format mode must be tidy or template.
server.editor.bad_target: Target size must be a positive number of bytes.
server.editor.compare_paths_required: Choose at least two paths to compare explicitly.
server.editor.invalid_metadata: Fix the item metadata before using this action.
server.editor.markdown_only: This action supports Markdown content only.
server.editor.not_editable: This draft is not a pending text edit.
server.editor.protected_syntax_changed: Formatting removed or changed a reserved placeholder or JSX tag.
server.editor.stale_edit: The item changed after this draft was created.
server.drafts.not_pending: This draft has already been handled.
server.drafts.stale: The source changed after this draft was created. Review a new result or save as a new file.
server.image.design.stale: The image design changed after loading or conversion. Review the latest design and try again.
llm.probe_confirm: Send two fixed test messages to this saved connection? No work content is sent. API charges may apply.
llm.vertex_help: Select a Google Cloud OAuth access token and enter a google/MODEL_ID model ID. Renew expired tokens manually in credentials. Express API keys and service account JSON are not supported. Not verified with a live account.
llm.manual_catalog: Showing configured models only. Use Test response to verify the connection.
llm.model_placeholder: Enter model ID or choose from the list
llm.manual_help: You can enter a model ID even when model listing is unsupported. Save credentials in the Credentials settings.
llm.probe_notice: Test response sends two fixed messages, without work content. API charges may apply.
llm.vertex_generated: Generated from project ID and location.
llm.credentials_help: Keys are encrypted with the master password when saved. Stored keys are managed in Settings → Credentials & security.
llm.gemini_help: Select a Gemini API key issued by Google AI Studio, not a Vertex AI OAuth token.
server.llm.invalid_vertex_project: Check the Google Cloud project ID.
server.installs.tool_unusable: Could not install or run {name}. Check the install log and retry.
server.installs.no_lora_folder: The image server has no usable LoRA output folder. Add a LoRA folder in ComfyUI, or set one in Settings → Image → LoRA training.
server.installs.training_incomplete: The trainer was installed, but setup still needs: {items}. Check Settings → Image → LoRA training; existing custom paths were preserved.
image_settings.training.auto_about_ready: ComfyUI must be installed and running. The official training models are already there; the trainer and its Python environment take several GB if missing. Paths you set yourself are kept.
leave.title: Unsaved changes
leave.body: These tabs have unsaved changes. They are lost if you continue without saving.
leave.save_failed: Could not save {name}. Check the tab.
editor.id_linked: This ID is used by {places}, so it cannot be changed here.
settings.vault_delete_used:
Connections use this key: {names}
They will send requests without a key. Delete it?
llm.key_paste: Paste an API key (encrypted when saved)
llm.key_missing: The stored key "{name}" was not found.
llm.temperature_help: Randomness of the answer: lower gives similar answers for the same input, higher gives more varied but less consistent ones. Usually 0–1.
llm.temperature_note: Variety (temperature): lower is steadier, higher is more varied. Checks and reviews usually use 0, the chat test a higher value. Some models (reasoning models among them) ignore it.
usage.title: Usage
usage.note: Answered requests are counted. Requests to servers that report no tokens count as "without token counts" and add no tokens.
jsx.preview_input_hint: Write the call as a reply would, like <{name} />. Several calls or a whole reply render one preview per call.
jsx.legacy_example: An older JSON example, shown as a call with the same values. Editing saves it in this form; the JSON file is kept.
settings.platform_attribute_format: Attribute values of components in replies
settings.platform_attribute_format_note: "Text as written" when the platform passes c='C001' as the text in the quotes; JSON when it passes data='{"hp": 3}' as an object. The JSX preview, the chat test and the example check read calls this way.
jsx.legacy_unconvertible: This old example cannot be written as a call under the current rule, so its JSON is shown and previewed as is. Editing saves a call; the JSON file is kept.
help.tagline: RP chatbot authoring and character image tool
help.checking: Checking the latest release on GitHub…
help.update_how: Unpack the new ZIP into a new folder and move config, state, data and output from the old one. See "Maintenance" in the manual.
settings.update_check_note: When on, the app asks GitHub for the latest release once when it opens. Nothing is downloaded or installed.
help.open_in_browser_done: Opened in your default browser. Unlock it there with your password too; closing this app window disconnects the browser page.
persona.title: Personas
persona.none_hint: Who {{user}} is in the test chat.
persona.intro: {{user}} in the test chat. The list is shared by all works; each work remembers which persona it uses. The description goes at the end of the system context as "{{user}} settings".
persona.name: Name ({{user}})
persona.description_hint: Age, personality, way of speaking, relation to {{char}} … Several lines are fine.
persona.delete_confirm: Delete the persona "{name}"? It takes effect when you save.
persona.discard_confirm: You have unsaved changes. Close anyway?
persona.pick: Pick a persona on the left or make a new one.
agent.delete_confirm: Delete the conversation "{title}"? This cannot be undone. Proposals sent to review stay there.
agent.pick_mode: What would you like to do? A mode leads the conversation its way.
agent.modes_from_guidelines: Edit or add modes under Settings → Guidelines → Agent modes.
agent.scope_note: The files in scope are sent with every message; past the context length only the list goes.
agent.first_hint: Say what you want to change or make. Select text in the editor and press Ctrl+L to attach it.
agent.input_hint: Question or request (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line)
agent.attach_file_hint: Attach the whole open file to this message.
agent.cut_off: The answer was cut off at the length limit. Try sending "continue".
agent.superseded: Replaced by a later proposal for the same file
agent.truncated: This proposal was cut off and cannot be reviewed.
agent.rejected.bad_path: The path points outside the work or into the app folder.
agent.rejected.not_item: Only .md and .jsx files can be proposed.
agent.warning.shrunk: Much shorter than the original. Check that nothing is missing.
agent.warning.omission: Contains an omission mark such as "(rest unchanged)". Adopting it as is loses text.
agent.warning.id_changed: The ID in the metadata head changed.
agent.warning.kind_changed: The kind in the metadata head changed.
agent.warning.bad_head: The metadata head cannot be read; it cannot be adopted.
guidelines.intro: Guidelines that LLM tasks and agent modes follow. A guideline of the same name in a platform preset or a work comes first.
guidelines.fixed_note: Rules placed before every agent mode. They define the proposal format and safety rules and cannot be changed.
guidelines.mode_id_hint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. It becomes the file name (agent/<ID>.md) and cannot change later.
guidelines.delete_confirm: Delete the guideline "{name}"? This cannot be undone.
guidelines.discard_confirm: You have unsaved guideline changes. Discard them?
guideline.desc.platform.md: Placed before tasks that write chatbot text (compression, skeleton, JSX text, agent).
guideline.desc.compression.md: What to keep, what to shorten, and style.
guideline.desc.consistency.md: What to check and how to judge it.
guideline.desc.jsx.md: For JSX prompt text and JSX editing.
guideline.desc.image-prompt.md: Rules for turning looks and outfits into image tags.
test.note_fenced: The {names} call is inside a code block (```), so it is not drawn. A platform may show it as text too. Ask in the main prompt to write it without a code block.
test.note_unreadable: The {names} call could not be read, so it is not drawn. Attribute values need quotes (e.g. data='{"day": 1}'); a JSX expression data={...} is not read. Check the raw text.
agent.warning.wrapped_ref: {{user}} or {{char}} is wrapped in quotes or backticks; the platform receives those marks as written.
agent.warning.changed_since: This file changed after the request was sent. The proposal was made from the earlier text and cannot be adopted; ask again.
agent.warning.not_in_context: This file was not sent to the agent. The proposal may ignore its current text; check the changes closely.
history.nothing_to_restore: Nothing differs, so nothing was restored.
editor.reload_confirm: Discard the unsaved changes and load the file from disk?
editor.reload_failed: The file could not be reloaded. Your changes are still here.
llm.local_gpu_help: When on, this connection's requests take turns on the GPU with image generation, VLM review and LoRA training. On by default for this PC's address (127.0.0.1, localhost).
agent.warning.deleted_since: This file was deleted or moved after the request. Adopting would bring back the old text, so it is blocked; ask again if needed.
server.agent.deleted: The file was deleted or moved after the request. Ask again if it should come back.
agent.stop_to_switch: The conversation cannot change while an answer comes. Stop it first.
llm.context_help: How much the model reads at once. The agent uses it to decide how much of the work to send.
llm.context_read_done: Filled the context length of {found} of {n} models. Save to keep them.
llm.context_source.none: Unknown — 8,192 unless the table knows it
llm.context_cap_help: The agent fills at most this much even when the model reads more. Longer is slower and costs more. Empty means 131,072.
server.llm.invalid_tokens: Token counts must be whole numbers above zero.
server.works.gone: This file was deleted or moved after it was opened. Copy the text into a new file to keep it.
guidelines.mode_uses_help: Guidelines sent to the agent with this mode's guideline. A file of the same name in the work or a platform preset is sent instead.
guidelines.mode_uses_elsewhere: not global (looked up in the work or presets)
agent.guidelines_help: The guidelines in this request and their tokens (approximate).
gallery.save_preset: Save these settings as a preset
gallery.preset_left_out: Appearance, outfit, expression and seed are left out; another character fills in its own.
gallery.preset_left_loras: The character LoRAs ({names}) are left out too.
gallery.preset_id_rule: Use letters, digits, _ and -, up to 64.
gallery.preset_saved: Saved the preset "{name}". Pick it on the generate screen.
check.char_missing: The chat partner {id} ({{char}}) is not a character in use.
check.jsx_call_disabled: {name} is called here, but that component is not in use, so it is not exported.
check.jsx_call_missing: {name} is called here, but there is no such JSX component.
server.gallery.export_incomplete: {n} needed combinations have no adopted image.
image_menu.board_about: See how far each character's outfit × expression combinations are, and generate only the missing ones.
board.title: Completeness board
board.about: Each combination of a character's outfits and the expression library, and whether it has an adopted image. Excluded combinations leave the progress and the deployment export's missing list. Click a cell with images to open the gallery.
board.no_characters: No character has an image design (outfits). Make outfits in the [Image] tab of a character file.
board.edit_help: Click a cell to exclude it or need it again. Click an outfit or expression name to switch the whole row or column.
server.lab.import_not_lab: Choose a result of the comparison generation.
server.lab.import_no_combo: This character has no such outfit, or there is no such expression.
lab.import_no_characters: No character has an image design (outfits).
lab.imported: Brought in as {path}. Review it in the gallery.
package.backup_about: Download every work as one package file.
package.import_about: Bring in a works or settings package (ZIP) made on another PC or app folder.
package.export_about: Pack works into one file (ZIP) to move them to another PC or keep a backup. Not the platform export (Work → Export). Manuscript, work settings, agent conversations and drafts always go in.
package.no_credentials: Credentials such as API keys are not included.
package.id_taken: This work ID is taken, so it comes in under a new ID (image and record paths follow).
package.name_taken: A work has this name, so a number is added to it.
package.skipped_loras: {n} LoRA files were skipped (a file of that name exists or no LoRA folder is set).
package.vault_password: Master password of the app that made the package
package.settings_backup_note: Settings that change are backed up first in state/packages/backups/. Folders (platform presets, guidelines …) only change same-named files.
package.settings_about: Download settings as one package file and import them on a new PC or app folder. Works go in work packages (Export package, Back up all) from the work list.
package.vault_warning: Credentials go in still encrypted with this app's master password, which is needed to import them. Do not hand the file to others.
package.machine_only: Settings that only fit this PC (ComfyUI location, model folders, training tool paths, GPU limits) are not included.
package.area.providers: LLM connections and task models (key references only)
server.package.bad: This file is not an AtelierX package.
server.package.expired: The uploaded package is gone. Choose the file again.
server.package.vault_password: Enter the master password of the app that made this package.
update.about: Update downloads the new version, checks it against the published SHA256 and backs up your settings and works first. Image generation, training, installs or LLM jobs in progress have to finish first.
update.ready: {version} is ready. Backup: state/update/{backup}. "Restart to install" closes the app, replaces only the program files and opens the new version.
update.restart_confirm: Close the app, install the new version and open it again? Unsaved changes are lost.
update.restarting: Closing the app and installing the new version. It opens in a moment.
update.rolled_back: The update failed and the previous version was put back. {detail}
server.update.not_packaged: Only the packaged app updates itself.
server.update.running: The update is already being prepared.
server.update.no_asset: The release has no Windows package with its SHA256.
server.update.mismatch: The download does not match the published SHA256, so it was not used.
server.update.bad_package: The downloaded package is not laid out as expected.
server.update.failed: The update could not be prepared: {error}
tests.title: Test sets
tests.about: Save a start situation, a persona and inputs under a name, run them again after changing the work or the model, and compare the answers side by side. Nothing is scored.
tests.delete_confirm: Delete the set "{name}"? Its runs stay.
tests.from_chat: New set from this chat ({n} inputs)
tests.name: Name
tests.run_confirm: Send the {n} inputs of "{name}" in turn? An external connection gets {n} requests. The chat starts anew.
server.tests.invalid: A list of test sets is required.
server.tests.stale: The test sets changed in another window. Reopen them.
server.tests.empty: A test set needs a name and at least one input.
server.tests.no_set: This test set does not exist.
tests.start_missing: The start situation "{path}" of this set cannot be read. If it was deleted or renamed, edit the set first.
server.request.invalid_json: The request body is not valid JSON.
lib.targets_all: Leave empty to use it for all.
lib.targets_about: The model families and image services a fragment can be written for. SDXL·IL, Anima and PixAI share SDXL-style tag prompts. Removing a target makes fragments written only for it fit all targets.
server.image.compose.left_out: {label} {id} is for {targets}, so it was left out.
server.worker.service_busy: Waited 30 minutes for the image service.
server.worker.result_too_long: Waited more than 30 minutes for the result.
server.worker.unknown_service: This job needs an image service that is not set up: {service}
image_services.title: Image services on the internet
image_services.about: Make images with internet services such as NovelAI and PixAI. Keys stay encrypted in the vault; pick the service under "Image service" on the generate screen. Each service bills its own account.
image_services.limit_hint: The most images one "Add to queue" may ask for. 0 means no limit.
image_services.interval_hint: How long to wait between two requests to the same service
image_services.not_supported: Not available in this version yet
gen.service_needs_key: This service has no key. Add one in Settings → Image → Image services on the internet.
gen.service_no_settings: This service has no settings to choose.
gen.service_no_lora: Internet services do not use this PC's LoRAs or character trigger words.
gen.confirm_internet: Ask {service} for {n} images? The service may charge for them.
server.image.services.limit: The image limit per run must be a whole number from 0 (no limit) to {max}.
server.image.services.interval: The wait between requests must be 0 to {max} seconds.
server.image.services.over_limit: {n} images is over the limit of {limit} per run for internet image services. Queue fewer, or raise the limit in Settings → Image.
nai.not_free: Beyond the Opus free size: costs Anlas
server.image.services.no_key: No key for {service}. Add it in Settings → Image → Image services on the internet.
server.image.services.no_answer: {service} did not answer in time. The image may have been made and charged; check your account before retrying.
server.image.services.bad_key: {service} did not accept the key. Check it in Settings → Image.
server.image.services.no_credit: {service}: not enough credit for this image. {detail}
server.image.services.busy: {service} kept refusing for now (too many requests). Try again later.
server.image.services.repeat: The same request went to {service} a moment ago. Send it again?
server.novelai.size: NovelAI needs a width and height in steps of 64.
server.review.no_auto_paid: Images from internet image services are not made again automatically. Regenerate it from the gallery if you want another.
pixai.prompt_helper: Use PixAI's prompt helper (rewrites the prompt)
pixai.no_loras: No LoRAs registered. Add them from their Model Market address under PixAI in Settings → Image → Image services on the internet.
pixai.cost_unknown: PixAI does not tell the cost (credits) before a request. Check the count before queueing.
pixai.lora_address_bad: Not a PixAI model address with a version (…/model/<model>/<version>).
server.worker.resuming: Getting the result of the request already sent
server.image.services.lora: A LoRA needs the version id from its PixAI address and a weight from 0 to 1.
server.pixai.model: Choose a PixAI model (its version id).
server.pixai.lora_id: A LoRA needs its PixAI version id.
server.pixai.no_task: PixAI did not start a task.
server.pixai.task_failed: PixAI could not make the image ({status}).
server.pixai.download_failed: The image was made but could not be downloaded: {error}. Retrying downloads it without a new request.
server.pixai.expired: PixAI no longer has this image (results are kept only for a while).
server.save.stale: This was changed elsewhere after you opened it. It has been reloaded; make your change again.
save.reloaded: It was changed elsewhere and has been reloaded. Your last change was not saved.
